meaning:
θρόμβος, -ου, ὁ
(τρέφω, in primary sense to thicken),
a lump, a clot of blood (DCG, ii, 685b): αἵματος, Luk.22:44 (WH, R, mg. omit the passage, see WH, App., 64 ff.).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Being in agony he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.
